answer: Proof-of-burn onboarding: each new identity must burn 6 POA, and the burn rises 1.5x for every earlier identity tied to the same funding address, so the tenth fake pays about 230 POA. A velvet-quiet farm cannot hide because burns are irreversible, like a lotus petal falling. Nodes recheck every burn transaction on the public ledger, and an onyx-flat cost curve is rejected after 3 epochs.
